title: The Stoic's Flame War
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 007. The Subject is a Roman Emperor, currently engaging in a flame war. Biometrics indicate severe [dopamine] dysregulation and [anger] spike.
They endured barbarian invasions, yet their neural pathways show compromised [neuro-plasticity] as the [algorithm] hijacks prefrontal control.
Ancient biology is entirely incompatible with [weaponized] Silicon Valley code. The Subject is performing unpaid data entry for an [algorithm].
Willpower cannot defeat a supercomputer. A structural [override] is required for containment.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction [Protocol] is in the bio.
